scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lensegua/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @lensegua/shared" "npm run dev -w @lensegua/api" "npm run dev -w @lensegua/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @lensegua/shared && npm run dev -w @lensegua/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lensegua/shared && npm run build -w @lensegua/api && npm run build -w @lensegua/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lensegua/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
